evals.prompt: 我在写一个包含批量删除和筛选的订单管理列表页，编码前帮我过一遍交互防御 SOP。
evals.expected_output: Rigorous 7-step interaction design review covering task flow, P0/P1/P2 information hierarchy, and 4 defensive states.
expectations: Executes through all 7 steps in sequential order (Intent -> Task Flow -> IA -> Resilience -> Perceived Perf -> Trade-off -> Output)
Classifies view elements strictly into P0 (vital), P1 (secondary), and P2 (progressive disclosure)
Fully specifies Empty, Loading, and Error states for the order table
Enforces explicit two-step / typed confirmation for destructive bulk deletion
Includes perceived performance optimizations (skeleton screens, optimistic updates, keyboard shortcuts)

evals.prompt: Design the interaction resilience and state defense logic for a high-value multi-currency checkout payment view.
evals.expected_output: Pre-coding interaction defense specification preventing double-billing, handling timeouts, and guiding user recovery.
expectations: Eliminates unnecessary friction from the checkout happy path
Specifies idempotent payment submission defense (disabling buttons, debouncing, optimistic state locks)
Defines clear network timeout and payment gateway failure recovery paths without loss of user input
Ensures destructive/high-risk actions require clear verification
Addresses responsive layout resilience (320px viewport to desktop, text overflow)
